questions.question: Find the number that is as much greater than 39 as is less than 79.
questions.solution:

questions.question: If the two lines px + 6y + 3 = 0 and 2x + qy + 3 = 0 have infinite solutions then find the value of p and q respectively.
questions.solution:
**Concept:**

For infinite solutions,

a1/a2 = b1/b2 = c1/c2

**Calculation:**

Line px + 6y + 3 = 0 when compared with a₁x + b₁y + c₁ = 0

So, a₁ = p, b₁ = 6 and c₁ = 3

Line 2x + qy + 3 = 0 when compared with a₂x + b₂y + c₂ = 0

So, a₂ = 2, b₂ = q and c₂ = 3

⇒ p/2 = 6/q = 3/3

⇒ p/2 = 3/3

⇒ p = 2

And, 6/q = 3/3

⇒ q = 6

So, value of p and q = 2,

questions.question: If A is 40% more than B, then B is how much percent less than A?
questions.solution:
Calculation:

Let B = 100

So, A = (100 + 40)% of B = 140% of 100 = 140

∴ Required % = (140 - 100)/140 × 100 = 2/7 × 100 = 28.57%

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**A = 140% of B

⇒ A/B = 7/5

The difference = 7 - 5 = 2 units.

The percentage difference = 2/7 × 100 = 28.57%

questions.question: A sum of money becomes 77/50 of itself in 18/5 years when invested at simple interest. What is the rate (in percentage) of interest per annum?
questions.solution:
**Concept used:**

• Simple interest = (P × T × R)/100, where P = principal, T = time, R = rate

• Amount = Simple interest + Principal

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

S.I. = Amount - Principal = 77P/50 - P = 27P/50

⇒ 27P/50 = (P × R × 18)/(100 × 5)

**∴ R = 30/2 = 15%**

questions.question: The ratio of the cost price and selling price of a bulb is 15 : 18. What is the profit percentage?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The ratio of Cost price and Selling price is 15 : 18

**Concept used:**

• Profit% = (S.P - C.P)/C.P × 100

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

C.P = 15 unit and S.P = 18 unit

Profit % = (18 - 15)/15 × 100 = 20%

**∴ The correct answer is 20%**

questions.question:
A shopkeeper offers the following 3 schemes. Which scheme has the maximum discount percentage?

I. Two successive discount of 20% and 25%

II. Buy 5 get 3 free

III. Buy 5 get 6
questions.solution:
Scheme I. Two successive discounts of 20% and 25%

So, effective discount for scheme I is = 20 + 25 - (20 × 25)/100 = 45 - 5 = 40%

Scheme II. Buy 5 get 3 free

So, effective discount for scheme II is = (Article get free)/(Total articles) × 100 = 3/(5 + 3) × 100 = 37.5%

Scheme III. Buy 5 get 6

So, effective discount for scheme III is = (Article get free)/(Total articles) × 100 = 1/(6 ) × 100 = 16.67%

So, answer is Scheme I.

M can complete 3/4 part of a work in 12 days and N can complete 2/7 part of the same work in 8 days. In how many days will both complete 11/14 part of the total work?
questions.solution:
**Concept used:**

Total work = Efficiency × Time

**Calculation:**

Time taken by M to complete 3/4 part of a work = 12 days

Time taken by M to complete whole work = 12 × 4/3 = 16 days

Time taken by N to complete 2/7 part of a work = 8 days

Time taken by N to complete whole work = 8 × 7/2 = 28 days

Total work = LCM of 16, 28 = 112 units

Efficiency of M = 112/16 = 7 units/day

Efficiency of N = 112/28 = 4 units/day

Efficiency of M and N together = 7 + 4 = 11 units/day

**∴ Time taken by M and N together to complete 11/14 part of work = 11/14 × 112 × 1/11 = 8 days**

questions.question: A train starts moving from a place X at 7:00 a.m. and arrives at another place Y at 1:00 p.m. on the same day. If the speed of the train is 15 m/s, then what will be the distance (in km) covered by the train?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The train travels from a place X at 7:00 a.m to place Y at 1:00 p.m,

Speed of the train = 15 m/s

**Concept used:**

Speed = Distance/Time

**Calculation:**

Time taken by train = 6 hours

Speed of train = 15 m/s = 15 × 18/5 = 54 km/hr

Speed of train = Distance/Time

⇒ 54 = Distance/6

**∴ Distance = 54 × 6 = 324 km**

questions.question: If the lengths of the two parallel sides of a trapezium are 8 cm and 10 cm and its area is 54 cm². Find the distance between its parallel sides (in cm).
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Area = 54 cm², the two parallel sides of a trapezium are 8 cm and 10 cm 

**Concept used:**

Area = 1/2 × (sum of parallel sides) × (Distance between parallel sides)

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

⇒ 54 = 1/2 × (8 + 10) × (Distance between parallel sides)

**∴ Distance between parallel sides = 54/9 = 6 cm**

questions.question: If the circumference of a circle is 22 cm, then what must be its area (in cm²)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The circumference of a circle is 22 cm

**Concept used:**

• Circumference of circle = 2πr

• Area of circle = πr²

Where r = radius and π = 22/7

**Calculation:**

Circumference of circle = 2πr = 2 × 22/7 × r = 22

⇒ r = 3.5 cm

**∴ Area of circle = πr² = 22/7 × 3.5 × 3.5 = 38.5 cm²**

questions.question: The total surface area of a cube is 337.5 cm². Find its side (in cm).

The total surface area of the cube = 6a2

**Calculation:**

⇒ 6a² = 337.5

⇒ a² = 56.25

⇒ a = 7.5 cm

**∴ Option 4 is the correct answer.**
